chunks.arabic_text: عَنْ مَمْلُوكٍ ادَّعَى أَنَّهُ حُرٌّ وَ لَمْ يَأْتِ بِبَيِّنَةٍ عَلَى ذَلِكَ أَشْتَرِيهِ

translations.en: About an owned slave who claimed that he was free, but did not bring evidence for that—may I buy him?

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the purchase of a slave who claims to be free without presenting proof. The Imam عليه السلام permits the purchase, indicating that a mere claim without bayyinah (legal evidence) is not sufficient to overturn the apparent legal status.
en.seo_question: Can a slave who claims to be free be bought if he has no evidence?

key_terms.مَمْلُوكٍ: an owned slave or bondsman under legal possession
